item.title: February 2026 Member Spotlight
item.description: Written by: Ellë Papadis2/3/26AJ is a senior in Media Communications graduating in May, and the local film buff. His show, The Plexi Film Show, focuses on movies, TV shows, and video games in a seasonal format. When he’s not focused on homework or his show, AJ likes to play video games, write scripts, hike, and hang out with his friends. AJ is easy to spot at meetings with his famous pink beanie and kind demeanor.

item.description: Written by: Ray Wisda Date: 3/1/26Nate Gearhart is a freshman in Media Communications and a sports fanatic. He has a show – On the Clock – that focuses on the NFL and NFL draft picks. item.title: A Generation’s Golden Moment: 46 Years in the Making
item.description: Written By: Sawyer Knierim 3/11/26Great moments are born from great opportunities—and this one was golden. On Sunday, February 22nd, more than thirty million Americans tuned in at 9 a.m. to watch the United States defeat Canada 2-1 in overtime and win gold for the first time since the 1980 Miracle on Ice—46 years to the day.
